title: Spartacus Bakes

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Oh hey, it's you! I mean, hey, how's it going?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh hey, it's you! I mean, hey, how's it going?

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: I am Spartacus and I have got some news for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am Spartacus and I have got some news for you.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: I was talking to that donut guy, Danetti, and he thinks we can do business together.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was talking to that donut guy, Danetti, and he thinks we can do business together.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: I got some great news. I was talking to that donut guy, Danetti, and he thinks we can do business together.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I got some great news. I was talking to that donut guy, Danetti, and he thinks we can do business together.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Yeah! I do the baking, he does the frying... dude's got some weird ideas but damn if it doesn't sound like a plan.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah! I do the baking, he does the frying... dude's got some weird ideas but damn if it doesn't sound like a plan.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Yeah "Doomnetti's"! What do you think?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah "Doomnetti's"! What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Screw CorpSec. You know how close I came to losing this dream. I'm not gonna let them stop me now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Screw CorpSec. You know how close I came to losing this dream. I'm not gonna let them stop me now.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Got any better ideas?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Got any better ideas?

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Ha! You know I like you... but not that much.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha! You know I like you... but not that much.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Ha! You might be smart but you cannot do names.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha! You might be smart but you cannot do names.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Not bad, I guess. I'll think about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not bad, I guess. I'll think about it.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: We're gonna call the place "Doomnetti's". What do you think?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We're gonna call the place "Doomnetti's". What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Oh, I know them. I'll see ya.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, I know them. I'll see ya.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Hey, thanks. Look, I gotta go, but come by soon, ok?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, thanks. Look, I gotta go, but come by soon, ok?

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Heh. Look, I gotta go, but come by soon, ok?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Heh. Look, I gotta go, but come by soon, ok?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let's hear it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's hear it!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: All the better for seeing you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All the better for seeing you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: All the better for seeing you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: All the better for seeing you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Same old. How's the baking?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Same old. How's the baking?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're going to start a shop?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're going to start a shop?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're going to start a shop?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're going to start a shop?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you have a name?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you have a name?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: CorpSec don't like collaboration much.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: CorpSec don't like collaboration much.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's a winner. Just like you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a winner. Just like you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's a winner. Just like you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's a winner. Just like you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I love it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I love it!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Eh, it's ok...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, it's ok...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: DoomNuts?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: DoomNuts?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sparty & Danny's?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sparty & Danny's?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Danetti & Doom?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Danetti & Doom?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're right. Tell me more.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're right. Tell me more.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just letting you know the risks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just letting you know the risks.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Just letting you know the risks.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Just letting you know the risks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Says you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Says you!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll take that as a compliment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll take that as a compliment.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll take that as a compliment.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll take that as a compliment.

nodes.text: Good job I like you too then.
